+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_streaming_response_on_websocket_scope() -> None:
+    background_calls = 0
+    sent: list[Message] = []
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        raise AssertionError("WebSocket denial responses should not receive HTTP disconnect events")
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        sent.append(message)
+
+    def run_background() -> None:
+        nonlocal background_calls
+        background_calls += 1
+
+    async def stream() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+        yield b"streamed "
+        yield b"denial"
+
+    response = StreamingResponse(stream(), status_code=401, background=BackgroundTask(run_background))
+    await response({"type": "websocket"}, receive, send)
+
+    assert background_calls == 1
+    assert sent[0]["type"] == "websocket.http.response.start"
+    assert sent[0]["status"] == 401
+    assert [message["type"] for message in sent[1:]] == [
+        "websocket.http.response.body",
+        "websocket.http.response.body",
+        "websocket.http.response.body",
+    ]
+    assert [message.get("more_body", False) for message in sent[1:]] == [True, True, False]
+    assert b"".join(message["body"] for message in sent[1:]) == b"streamed denial"
+
